name: Merge & Steal Brainrot 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Merge & Steal Brainrot is a fast-paced web game for desktop and mobile where you merge, drag, and strategize your way through the chaotic universe of Steal a Brainrot. Combine identical brainrots by dragging and dropping them together to unlock stronger, rarer, and even more unhinged evolutions.
